description: Group rows by one column and calculate count, sum, average, minimum or maximum for a numeric field. Up to 32 MiB input, 50,000 rows and 200 columns. CSV cells remain strings unless an operation explicitly parses numeric values. No uploaded code is executed. Null and empty numeric cells are excluded from numeric aggregates. Non-numeric values cause an error. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: data_aggregate
title: Group and aggregate data
